# Monarch Mail

> Monarch Mail is a shipping, mailbox, and print store in Stone Oak, San Antonio, Texas. The physical storefront is closing after Wednesday, November 25, 2026. Services continue with no storefront through Tezal Consulting.

Contact: email contact@themonarchmail.com (best), or text or call 210.265.5805.

Hours: Mon–Fri 10:00 AM–5:30 PM through Wed Nov 25, 2026; Saturdays by appointment; closed Sundays. Post-closing services: hello@tezalconsulting.com.

## Key dates
- Regular hours through Nov 25, 2026: Mon–Fri 10:00 AM–5:30 PM; Saturdays by appointment; closed Sundays.
- Wed, Nov 25, 2026: last day for retail, mail pickup, and package pickup. Mailbox keys due back to avoid a $10 fee.
- Thu, Nov 26: closed (Thanksgiving).
- Fri Nov 27 – Mon Nov 30: sale only for remaining inventory and fixtures.
- Mail received through Nov 30 can be forwarded at the customer's expense if arranged in advance.
